en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a hillside town or city, photographed from a grassy field in the foreground. Dense clusters of early‑20th‑century houses and villas with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows cover the slope. Larger masonry buildings, including what appear to be churches with towers and a substantial institutional building, stand out among the residences. The upper hillside shows terraced or cultivated fields, patches of forest, and several isolated villas. Two tall structures rise on the ridge line: one resembles a mast or narrow tower, and another squat structure stands on a cleared terrace. A leafless tree frames the right side of the picture. There is no visible printed caption or back text, only the photographic scene itself.
